sn35.69:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca upaseno rājagahe viharanti sītavane sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre.
sn35.69:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upasenassa kāye āsīviso patito hoti.
sn35.69:1.3: atha kho āyasmā upaseno bhikkhū āmantesi
sn35.69:1.4: etha me āvuso imaṃ kāyaṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā bahiddhā nīharatha
sn35.69:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ upasenaṃ etadavoca
sn35.69:2.2: na kho pana mayaṃ passāma āyasmato upasenassa kāyassa vā aññathattaṃ indriyānaṃ vā vipariṇāmo.
sn35.69:2.4: etha me āvuso imaṃ kāyaṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā bahiddhā nīharatha
sn35.69:2.8: ahaṃ cakkhunti vā mama cakkhunti vā …pe…
sn35.69:2.10: ahaṃ manoti vā mama manoti vā
sn35.69:2.11: tassa āvuso sārīputta siyā kāyassa vā aññathattaṃ indriyānaṃ vā vipariṇāmo.
sn35.69:2.12: mayhañca kho āvuso sārīputta na evaṃ hoti
sn35.69:2.13: ahaṃ cakkhunti vā mama cakkhunti vā …pe…
sn35.69:2.14: ahaṃ jivhāti vā mama jivhāti vā …pe…
sn35.69:2.15: ahaṃ manoti vā mama manoti vā
sn35.69:2.16: tassa mayhañca kho āvuso sārīputta kiṃ kāyassa vā aññathattaṃ bhavissati indriyānaṃ vā vipariṇāmoti.
sn35.69:3.1: tathā hi panāyasmato upasenassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā
sn35.69:3.2: tasmā āyasmato upasenassa na evaṃ hoti
sn35.69:3.3: ahaṃ cakkhunti vā mama cakkhunti vā …pe…
sn35.69:3.4: ahaṃ jivhāti vā mama jivhāti vā …pe…
sn35.69:3.5: ahaṃ manoti vā mama manoti vāti.
sn35.69:3.6: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmato upasenassa kāyaṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā bahiddhā nīhariṃsu.
